select o.id,o.order_no as orderNo,o.pay_amount as payAmount,o.status,o.create_time as createTime, u.nickname as buyerName,m.shop_name as merchantName,o.receiver_name as receiverName, o.receiver_address as receiverAddress,o.receiver_phone as receiverPhone,o.pay_time as payTime,o.source from `order` o left join merchant_profile m on m.user_id = o.merchant_id left join user_profile u on o.user_id = u.user_id
and order_no like concat('%', #{dto.orderNo}, '%')
and m.shop_name like concat('%', #{dto.merchantName}, '%')
and u.nickname like concat('%', #{dto.buyerName}, '%')
and o.deleted = 0
order by m.create_time desc
select ifnull(sum(pay_amount),0) from `order` where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and status in (1,2,3) and date(create_time) = curdate()
